p_rows = data_rows('Providers', {'C': 'number', 'D': 'string'})
providers = {}
for r in p_rows:
    cost = num('Providers', f'C{r}')
    name = label('Providers', f'D{r}')
    providers[name] = cost

c_rows = data_rows('Coverage', {'C': 'string', 'D': 'string'})
coverage = {}
for r in c_rows:
    prov = label('Coverage', f'C{r}')
    area = label('Coverage', f'D{r}')
    coverage.setdefault(prov, set()).add(area)

r_rows = data_rows('Required', {'C': 'string'})
required = set(label('Required', f'C{r}') for r in r_rows)

prov_list = list(providers.keys())
n = len(prov_list)
best_cost = None
best_set = []

for i in range(1 << n):
    sel_provs = [prov_list[j] for j in range(n) if (i & (1 << j))]
    covered = set()
    cost = 0
    for p in sel_provs:
        cost += providers[p]
        if p in coverage:
            covered.update(coverage[p])
    if required.issubset(covered):
        if best_cost is None or cost < best_cost:
            best_cost = cost
            best_set = sorted(sel_provs)

result = ', '.join(best_set)
